interpretation.purpose: Frozen old algorithm outputs, NOT NASA/JPL accuracy validation. Never auto-update.
interpretation.time: Input JD is a numeric legacy argument. years=(inputJD-JD_START)/365.25; production recomputes JD_START+years*365.25. Runtime utcNowYears uses Date.now minus UTC START_MS divided by YEAR_S. No demonstrated UTC->TT/TDB or leap-second conversion.
interpretation.coordinates: Raw production physical coordinates before scene compression, camera transforms or display scaling.
interpretation.earth: Earth coefficients identify the approximate EMB slot; production treats it as Earth without barycenter-to-geocenter correction. Preserved, not fixed.
interpretation.validity: Source comments cite planetary elements 1800-2050 and Ceres fit 2006-2046; some requested dates are outside a cited interval. Comments/accuracy claims are not independently verified.
interpretation.encoding: JSON decimal Numbers round-trip IEEE-754 binary64; float64HexBE stores 8-byte big-endian bit patterns including signed zero.
interpretation.repeatability: Exact comparison expected in recorded runtime; cross-runtime/platform transcendental last-bit equality is not guaranteed.
